profile.headline: Senior Software Developer - Fullstack
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer with 12+ years of development experience. Most versed in Front End technologies (JavaScript and React), but open to working with other languages and frameworks, and have done so in the past. 

I also bring a significant video background from a past life in Los Angeles. Looking to create rich, responsive multimedia experiences for web and mobile, as building out UI features that directly affect the end user's experience excites me the most.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer - Fullstack
positions.description:
Large Corporate Tax Preparation Client - As a Senior Frontend Software Developer and React SME, for the first 5 months, my role was to lead the pod responsible for the Gather section of the application, which included Personal Information viewing and editing, developing dashboard UI for very nuanced tax document statuses, and creating a document viewer with extracted fields interface that highlighted key areas of tax forms.

I then joined the Core team, focusing on the critical user-facing features that directly impact the tax preparation workflow for thousands of users. There, I led front end efforts on the v2 user interface of our AI-powered conversations feature, where I architected and implemented sophisticated React components using Next.js 14, TypeScript, and modern design patterns, including complex data tables, interactive forms, and real-time collaborative interfaces that handle sensitive financial data with enterprise-grade security considerations, directly enhancing the platform's core value proposition of AI-assisted tax advisory services.

Currently, I'm building interfaces on our Review Intelligence team for our 2 year comparison, tax preparer notes, anomalies, entity selections, and other rich, AI backed features that add tremendous user value and are central to the tax preparation workflow.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Built first version of iOS and Android mobile counterpart application (React Native) of an established experts/consulting marketplace web application.
- Co-led frontend work on a greenfield mobile application, including establishing initial conventions on a common components library, and establishing monorepo repositories (TurboRepo). 
- Owned an entire flow of the application that enabled the user to select their availability from a weekly agenda view, and submit their updated availability. This included complex features like batch selection with tap and hold gestures, mode switching with longpress, and timezone switching. 
- Integrations with MS Outlook and Google Calendar were also supported to mark busy slots on the UI, and toggle which calendars to enable. 
- Performance was maintained/optimized across the flow which was initially very render-intensive, and scalability was a priority as well, as the Calendar Linking feature was reused in various parts of the app.
- Worked across the codebase on crucial features like deep-linking 
- Presented internally and externally in client demos to a crowd of varied technical expertise. 
- Educated the client dev team on React, React Native, and other associated technologies needed to maintain the application, and produced documentation for knowledge transfer.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led FE efforts on Ascension's Messaging web application. 
- Built and documented the Compose API, enabling users to send messages from anywhere in the application. and is consumed/reused by multiple teams across a handful of modules. 
- Also implemented: filtering, attachments, deep linking features.
- Conducted regular demos to major stakeholders
- Onboarded 4 devs to the team quickly. They were shipping meaningful features to production within their first sprint, increasing team velocity.
- Mentored 2 direct reports.

- Built a NextJS eCommerce headless web application for Humana's OTC pharmacy on behalf of BCG. 
- React and Tailwind used on the front end, while leading Salesforce Commerce Cloud (formerly Demandware) integration on the back end. 
- Led documentation efforts for client handoff.

- Built out Front End for a large eCommerce web app, Insight.com, on behalf of BCG. Pages Included product detail pages, list pages, and checkout flow. 
- Among technologies used: Next.JS, Vercel, Docker.

- Migrated Intermountain Healthcare's web and mobile apps to use new services. 
- Responsibilities ranged from feature adds to resolving their top 2 longstanding Android bug crashes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
A front end development role for multiple agile teams responsible for the InsightVM product, a dashboard that helps inform customers how their assets are vulnerable to attack. UI/UX features are developed in React, and tested with Jest.

Grand Prize Winning team in the 2019 internal company-wide hackathon (approx 80 teams)

honors.title: Internal 5BAR7GWDH Hackathon Grand Prize Winner

projects.title: BlockTalk
projects.description:
Group project for MakerSquare.

JQuery intensive web app, designed to allow two individuals to schedule a time to meet.  Uses JQuery UI, as well as Moment.js to allow the first user to select available times, then send the resulting link to the second user, allowing them to select the final time.  A mailer then sends an email to both participants, with an iCalendar invite.
